response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, s.shortintrt, s.optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
),
tx AS (
  SELECT transreg, ordertypedist,
         AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_shortintrt,
         AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS base_shortintrt
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT tx.transreg AS transref,
       tx.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
       tx.avg_shortintrt,
       tx.avg_optvolrt,
       tx.avg_shortintrt / NULLIF(b.base_shortintrt, 0) AS short_interest_ratio
FROM tx
JOIN baseline b ON b.ordertypedist IS NOT DISTINCT FROM tx.ordertypedist
ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each transaction has one ordertypedist value (transactionrecord.transreg is the primary key), so grouping by transaction and mix gives one row per transaction. AVG ignores NULL shortintrt and optvolrt values, as the request asks. The baseline is the AVG of shortintrt over all matched snapshot rows in the same mix, so each snapshot counts once. A NULL ordertypedist is treated as its own mix rather than dropped, using IS NOT DISTINCT FROM. The ratio is NULL when the baseline is NULL or zero, which avoids division by zero and sorts last.
